title: I made a whole list of what to check for each instrument before a trade!
author: KimOnMacro
selftext:
Before jumping into technical analysis, I think it's worth checking what else is happening around the instrument you're about to trade. Every instrument has different things that can give you useful context.  


For example:  
  
**Before trading AUDUSD, I'd check:**

1. Copper/Gold as australia exports a lot of commodities, so stronger commodity demand can support AUD.
2. DXY shows how strong or weak the US dollar is overall.
3. US and australia yield difference as shows which country's bonds are paying more, which can affect where money wants to go.

  
**Before trading XAUUSD Id check:**

1. Real yields as higher real yields can make gold less attractive.
2. DXY as gold is priced in USD, so the dollar matters.
3. Silver as if silver is moving with gold, it gives more confirmation to a gold move
4. VIX Futures ETF as it gives you a quick idea of how much fear there is in markets.

**\*\*Screenshots here are a few other examples E.g. Nvidia, Crude oil** 

  
**I added this list as a mini feature inside my app's pre-trade analysis for 35 instruments.**  
  
For whichever instrument you're looking at, it gives you a tailored list of what to watch, shows the actual changes beside them, and lets you switch between 1H, 4H and 1D. 

Most of the market data updates every minute through Twelve Data. Things like real yields and yield differences come from FRED, so those update when the underlying data is released.   
  
  
**You can also just copy these lists and just check certain tickers manually, especially if you only trade a few instruments.** It just gets annoying once you trade a lot of different things because every instrument watches something slightly different.   


**Free to use here:**  
[https://echelonedgeai.com/](https://echelonedgeai.com/)

I do wonder if you normally check these things? or more like a quick check in DXY? Or just dont check and use technical analysis only?

comments.author: Livid_Parsnip_2816
comments.body: Useful list. In Mother Superior I use this kind of information as regime context, not as one big on/off switch. DXY and real yields can affect the trend and breakout modules differently from the scalping side. One macro filter controlling every gold trade felt too fragile.
